title: migronaut configuration
description: Configuration for migronaut.config.json. Options that hold live instances or functions (hooks, logger, mongoose, client, generateId, telemetry) are only available in a .ts/.js config.

$schema.description: URL of this schema, for editor completion and validation

lockCollection.description: Collection used for the concurrency lock

convergeLogCollection.description: Collection holding the converge history (written on the first converge that changes something)

lockTTLSeconds.description: Seconds before a lock is considered stale and reclaimable

strict.description: Abort (instead of warn) when an applied file's checksum no longer matches

useTransaction.description: Wrap every migration in a transaction. Requires a replica set or sharded cluster

createExtension.description: File type `migronaut create` generates by default

sequential.description: Use 0001-style sequential numbering instead of timestamps

templatePath.description: Path to a custom migration template file

environment.description: Value stamped on changelog records. Defaults to NODE_ENV, then 'production'

onLockLost.description: What to do when the lock is lost mid-run

onOutOfOrder.description: What a bulk `up` does when a pending migration sorts before the newest applied one (a file merged late from a parallel branch)

envFile.description: The .env file to load, or false to load none

ensureIndexes.description: Create the changelog indexes on first connect

timeoutMs.description: Abort the run when a single migration exceeds this many milliseconds

reloadMigrations.description: Bypass the ESM module cache when loading migrations (long-lived processes)

clientOptions.description: MongoDB driver options (MongoClientOptions): TLS, auth mechanisms, proxies, pool sizing. Passed to the driver as-is.

collections.description: Declared collections: `migronaut converge` keeps their indexes and validator in the declared state, with no migration file per change

collectionsDir.description: Directory of collection definition files, one collection per file. Opt-in: nothing is read unless this is set

convergeAfterUp.description: End every bulk `up` (no file, no --to) by converging the declared collections under the same lock

indexes.description: Every index besides _id. Omit to leave the collection's indexes unmanaged

validator.description: A query or { $jsonSchema } document; null or {} for no validator. Omit to leave the validator unmanaged

validationLevel.description: How the validator applies to updates. Defaults to 'strict'

validationAction.description: What an invalid write does. Defaults to 'error'

prune.description: Drop indexes this definition does not declare (otherwise they are kept and reported)

name.description: Defaults to the name MongoDB generates (email_1)

background.description: Accepted and ignored — a no-op since MongoDB 4.2
